sections.heading: 1. Support it and take breaks
lines: ① Rest the tray on your whole palm.
② Heavy? Use two hands or split it.
③ Gentle wrist stretch, 15 sec each way.
④ Open and close your fist, 10 times.

caption:
Momo carries dozens of trays through the café lunch rush, and lately her wrist and forearm feel achy.

Holding a tray far from your body with the wrist bent can keep the forearm muscles working hard. Keeping it close and supported on your whole palm can share the load.

Hybi's tip: palm under the tray, two hands or two trips when it's heavy, and a quick wrist stretch between orders.

Finger tingling that keeps coming back, swelling or weakness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
